name: wyrm-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, navigation and completion (via wyrm-lsp) for the Wyrm scripting language

wyrm.interpreterPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `wyrm` interpreter used to run files. Leave empty to auto-detect: tries `${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/wyrm`, then `wyrm` on `PATH`. Use the **Wyrm: Select Interpreter** command (or the status bar item) to pick one. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `~`.

wyrm.modulePath.markdownDescription: Directories to search for `import`ed modules, in order — passed to the interpreter and the language server as `WYRM_PATH`. Each entry supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `~`; relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Edit with the **Wyrm: Edit Module Search Path** and **Wyrm: Add Folder to Module Search Path** commands.

wyrm.modulePathInheritEnvironment.markdownDescription: Append any `WYRM_PATH` inherited from the environment VS Code was launched in to `#wyrm.modulePath#`, instead of replacing it.

wyrm.lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `wyrm-lsp` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect: the `wyrm-lsp` next to `#wyrm.interpreterPath#`, then `${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/wyrm-lsp` (this repo's own dev layout), then `wyrm-lsp` on `PATH`.

wyrm.lsp.enable.description: Enable the wyrm-lsp language server (diagnostics, outline, go-to-definition, hover, completion).

commands.title: Add Folder to Module Search Path (WYRM_PATH)
